title: Gjilan — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Gjilan: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Gjilan has a population of 54,000. A city in eastern Kosovo known for its textile industry, the Gjilan Fortress, and the nearby Mirusha Waterfalls natural attraction. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 149 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
